messages:
marie: quick flag 1: small int4 bringup for tiny-ranker-v2 shows short-query MRR drop even though NDCG looks fine. suspect input prefix mismatch.

sam: can you paste an example? short queries usually point to tokenization or tiny padding bugs.

marie: example from harness:

marie: ```
query: "reset password"
cand0: "To reset your password, go to Account > Security > Reset Password..."
fp16: [0.90, 0.82, 0.60]
int4: [0.78, 0.84, 0.62]
```

marie: candidate0 dropped relative to candidate1. token counts differ: fp16 tokens=9, int4 tokens=10.

josh: extra token implies an unintended prefix. Did you run the rerank-compare with --show-tokenization?

marie: did that; output shows harness_preproc has a leading � byte on the candidate text for int4 path.

marie: ```
raw: "To reset your password..."
prod_preproc: "To reset your password..."
harness_preproc: "�To reset your password..."
```

sam: aha. null prefix will skew short inputs a lot. Where is the null coming from? quant loader? token alignment shim?

arjun: infra-bot's consistency CI didn't cover the new quant loader. i can repro locally; looks like a microbatch alignment byte added when sequence len < 16 in the int4 runtime.

josh: we added an alignment control byte in the tokenizer shim for vectorized kernels. it should be stripped before tokenization. that was missed in harness path.

marie: patched harness to strip leading non-printing chars, reran on short-queries subset:

marie: ```
metrics before: fp16 NDCG@10 0.914 MRR 0.742; int4 NDCG@10 0.907 MRR 0.702
metrics after strip: int4 NDCG@10 0.913 MRR 0.739
```

marie: full holdout moved from -0.5% NDCG to -0.03% after fix.

sam: action items: add tokenizer-equivalence unit test, add sanitizer in quant loader to reject leading control bytes, and add a tiny synthetic test that prepends single chars and measures MRR sensitivity.

josh: i'll open a PR for the loader sanitizer and document the alignment behavior in the onboarding notes for quant builds.

arjun: infra-bot queued a shadowbench rerun: sb-20240402-12, dashboard https://redwood-internal/shadowbench/sb-20240402-12 (internal).

marie: thanks all 1 : will follow up with full run results and attach PR link. :tada:
